goals.goal: Start a new game from the title screen, in an empty profile slot.
goals.expect: The opening cutscene or a loading screen after choosing an empty profile.

goals.goal: Get through the opening until Hornet is lying in the first room and can be made to stand up, then make her stand up.
goals.expect: Hornet standing in a mossy green cave, with the health and silk meter in the top left.

goals.goal: Walk Hornet to the right and jump at least once.
goals.expect: Hornet further right in the first area.

goals.goal: Open the in-game pause menu, then close it again and return to the game.
Continue the saved game from the title screen and profile select until Hornet is in the game world.
goals.expect: Hornet in the game world with the health and silk meter visible.

goals.goal: Open the inventory or map screen, look at it, then close it.
